name: Lucian Freud
bio: Lucian Michael Freud was a British painter and draughtsman, specialising in figurative art, who is known as one of the foremost 20th-century English portraitists.

paintings.title: Portrait of Kitty
paintings.story: Portrait of Kitty is a painting by Lucian Freud of Kitty Garman, his wife and the eldest daughter of the sculptor Jacob Epstein and Kathleen Garman. Completed between 1948 and 1949, this oil on board measures 35 by 24 centimetres.
facts: "Kitty" Garman was the eldest daughter of the sculptor Jacob Epstein and his lover Kathleen Garman.
Epstein and Katherine Garman were together for over thirty years before they married in 1955, after the death of Epstein's first wife Margaret.

paintings.title: Portrait of Elizabeth II (Freud)
paintings.story: Portrait of Elizabeth II, also known as Her Majesty the Queen or Queen Elizabeth II, is an oil portrait on canvas of Queen Elizabeth II by Lucian Freud. It was completed in 2001 and unveiled to a mixed reception. Following Elizabeth's death in 2022, the ownership of the painting is unclear.
facts: He painted the portrait in the Friary Court picture conservation studio of the Royal Collection at St James's Palace.
Adrian Searle of The Guardian felt that it was the finest portrait of a royal for 150 years and that "Freud has got beneath the powder, and that itself is no mean feat ...

paintings.title: After Cézanne
paintings.story: After Cezanne is a large, irregular shaped, obtuse painting done in oils on canvas, begun in 1999 and completed in 2000 by the British artist Lucian Freud. The top left section of this painting has been 'grafted' on to the main section below, and closer inspection reveals a horizontal line where these two sections were joined.

paintings.title: Benefits Supervisor Sleeping
paintings.story: Benefits Supervisor Sleeping is an oil on canvas painting by the British artist Lucian Freud, from 1995. It is held in a private collection.

paintings.title: Naked Child Laughing (painting)
paintings.story: Naked Child Laughing is an oil on canvas painting by Lucian Freud of a nude girl laughing, done in 1963. It is held in a private collection.
facts: It was also one of the several that he did during his career of his own children, in different ages.
This painting shows his eldest daughter, Annie, then aged 14 years old, as a naked teenage girl, sitting on a settee and laughing.

paintings.title: The Brigadier (painting)
paintings.story: The Brigadier is a 2004 oil on canvas painting by the British artist Lucian Freud (1922–2011). It is a larger than life seven foot high portrait of Andrew Parker Bowles. In 2015 the work sold at auction at Christie's in New York City for $34.89 million.
facts: Parker-Bowles has himself offered that he had the opportunity to purchase the work, but did not have "three or four million to spare".
Instead it was first acquired by the American investment banker Damon Mezzacappa.
The painting was then put up for auction following the wealthy Floridian's death in April 2015.

paintings.title: Head on a Green Sofa
paintings.story: Head on a Green Sofa is an oil painting by Lucian Freud executed in 1960-1961. It is held in a private collection.
